messages:
erin.dev: spotted a possible authz leak in /dashboard/api/users in staging. role field is returned for any user id if you call GET /api/users?ids[]=... even without admin scope. repro steps below.

erin.dev: curl -i 'https://stg.app.internal/api/users?ids[]=123' -H 'Authorization: Bearer user-token'

erin.dev: response snippet:
```
[{
  "id": "123",
  "name": "Alice",
  "role": "admin",
  "avatar_url": "https://avatars.example.com/123.png"
}]
```

sam.security: omg that's sensitive. role disclosure + we also saw the avatar_url proxied through image service — that could be SSRF if host header accepted.

mike-ops: deploy-bot shows deploy at 1799002200 to webapp-staging (release/feature/user-list). Did this change the serialization?

deploy-bot: Deploy webapp-staging release/feature/user-list finished: 1799002200 :rocket:

jess: +1 on SSRF surface. image proxy accepts full URL param? check image-proxy upstream headers.

erin.dev: reproduction: if avatar_url is set to "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/" the proxy fetches it from internal network and returns 200 body starting with "ami-id". confirmed on staging.

sam.security: containment: 1) disable image-proxy for public user avatars (feature flag: images.allow_external_previews) 2) remove role from public listing responses 3) add RBAC check on /api/users to require admin scope.

mike-ops: toggled flag images.allow_external_previews=false in staging at 1799002401. canary in prod scheduled but hold until tests.

erin.dev: rolled quick patch to user serializer to redact role for non-admins and deployed to staging canary (release/patch/redact-role) 1799002460. logs: "users.serializer: redacted role for non-admin".

olivia.ps: I'm loopin in security-comms and legal. we should treat this as P1 until prod is patched. drafting customer comms if any sensitive data exposed.

jess: audit note: check KMS access logs for any unusual decryption around that time? not directly related but include in post-incident list.

sam.security: action items: (a) confirm no prod exposure by scanning logs for GET /api/users with role returned to non-admin tokens (query ES); (b) run image-proxy CVE checklist and add host allowlist; (c) add unit tests for serializer to ensure role omitted; (d) RBAC middleware audit to hard-fail when missing admin scope. I'll own (a) and (d).

erin.dev: I will open PR for serializer tests and link to this thread. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/4321

mike-ops: creating incident:INC-2026-14, page on-call, set severity P1, runbook attached.

olivia.ps: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10am PT, invite eng, security, product, legal. also create follow-up tickets (security backlog) for WAF rule and KMS audit.

sam.security: good work. keep short updates here. after we confirm no prod leakage we'll de-escalate.

erin.dev: update: ES scan shows no prod requests returning "role" to non-admin tokens between 1799002000-1799002800. continuing checks.

mike-ops: prod canary hold removed at 1799002700 after manual qa. full prod rollout blocked until 2FA for admin endpoints is verified.

olivia.ps: noted. documenting communications and next steps.
